branding.description: Branding configuration that can be set globally or for an individual site.
branding.title: BrandingConfig

maxContentLengthBytes.description: Set Maximum Document Content Length in Bytes

maxDocuments.description: Set Maximum number of Documents allowed

maxWebhooks.description: Set Maximum number of Webhooks allowed

notificationEmail.description: Deprecated. Use notification.email instead. Email address to use for SES notifications.

email.description: Email address to use as the From address for notifications

credentialsSecretArn.description: AWS Secrets Manager ARN for a secret whose value is a JSON object containing non-empty string properties named "username" and "password", for example: {"username":"smtp-user@example.com","password":"smtp-password"}.

softDeleteRetentionInDays.description: Number of days to retain soft deleted documents before permanent deletion. Use -1 to retain soft deleted documents until trash is cleared manually.

maxPagesPerTransaction.description: Max number of OCR pages (-1 for unlimited)

maxTransactions.description: Max number of OCR actions that can be created (-1 for unlimited)

environment.description: Docusign environment. When omitted from an E-Signature request, defaults to docusignEnvironment in the site configuration.
environment.title: DocusignEnvironment

hmacSignature.description: Optional HMAC secret used to validate Docusign Connect event notifications. When configured, callbacks must include a matching Docusign HMAC signature. When omitted or empty, callbacks are processed without HMAC validation, including when connectUrl is configured.

connectUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives Docusign Connect event notifications. May be configured with or without hmacSignature.
